title: Slot Machine
description: A three-reel slot machine: SPIN calls `next({ count })` on three vertical loop carousels with staggered durations.
steps: Each reel is a vertical `loop` carousel of 16 symbols whose `itemAnimation` bends it into a cylinder: 24° per symbol with `perspective` 600 and `rotateX`.
SPIN calls `next({ count: 24 + rand + 6 * k })` on reel k (rand is 0–15), and `animation` durations of 1500, 2050 and 2600 ms stop the reels left to right.
`onSnapToItem` reports each reel's symbol; once all three have stopped, three 7s pay 300, any three of a kind 100 and any pair 10.
